title: Finite-codimensional subspaces of Daugavet spaces: projection constants and minimal projections
summary: Over the real or complex field, we establish a duality formula for projection constants of finite-codimensional subspaces of Banach spaces with the Daugavet property. If \[ Y=\bigcap_{j=1}^n \ker f_j \subset X, \qquad W=\operatorname{span}\{f_1,\dots,f_n\} \subset X^*, \] then \[ λ(Y,X)=1+λ(W,X^*), \] and minimal projections onto $Y$ correspond exactly to weak$^*$-continuous minimal projections onto $W$.
